Dana: Quick thread - drafting internal release note + runbook for Tue 02:00 UTC window. Need ops + comms signoff.

Dana: ```
Release v2.3.1 (patch)
- Fix: dispatcher memory leak under burst (fewer OOMs)
- Tune: KV cache heuristics (~12% token cost reduction)
- Ops: canary pinned internally; auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if p99 >200ms for 10m
- Impact: no API changes; SDK patch bump only
```

Rory: Please add exact pin + rollback CLI lines and one-line rollback criteria.

Dana: Added:
- Internal pin: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal --actor @Rory`
- Public flip: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope public --actor @Mei`
- Rollback: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms_10m"`
- Criteria (short): sustained p99 >200ms for 10m OR error rate >3x baseline

Mei: Comms note - internal announce includes CLI and runbook; public blurb must be customer-friendly: "Patch to improve service stability; no action required." I'll prepare both.

ops-oncall: Roster: @ops-oncall (primary), @Kai (backup). I'll watch 01:50-04:00 UTC and open #incident if criteria hit. Confirmed.

Rory: Runbook condensed:
1) T-30m: post internal announcement (Dana)
2) T0 (02:00 UTC): run internal pin, start health checks (10m automated)
3) If stable: wait 90m then run public flip (Mei posts public blurb)
4) If rollback criteria met: run rollback CLI and post reason; ops open incident channel

deploy-bot: scheduled window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, duration=30m, change-id=ch_999111, canary=true, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Dana: PR with full copy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/499. Please review by EOD. I'll post internal announce at T-30m and run the internal pin unless ops prefers to run it.

Mei: I'll attach the public snippet to the PR and queue it for T+90m after internal thumbs-up.

Rory: I'll execute internal pin and stay on the thread for the flip/rollback.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Roster and monitor set.

Dana: Locking this for prep. Re-open if any late edits.
